# How to fix activation and onboarding

## Transcript

Lenny (00:00:00):
Welcome. Today we talk about activation and onboarding for B2B SaaS products.

Alice Example (00:00:30):
Activation is the moment a new user first experiences the core value of your product. Most teams measure signups, but signups hide the real problem. We found that users who invited a teammate in the first day retained at three times the rate, so we redesigned onboarding around that single moment.

Lenny (00:01:40):
How did you find that moment?

Alice Example (00:01:50):
We ran a cohort analysis comparing retention curves for users who did and did not complete each onboarding step. The invite step stood out. Then we ran an experiment that removed every other step from the first session, and activation rose by twenty percent.

Alice Example (00:03:10):
The mistake teams make is adding more tooltips. Cut steps instead. Retention follows activation, so fix the first session before you touch lifecycle emails.
